Alex —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. The clinical team liked the latency and the evaluation results on our sample notes. A couple of items before we can commit to the pilot:

1) Timeline: we need a 6-week evaluation (technical + clinical validation) with an exec review at the end. Can you confirm you can deliver the environment and initial model variant by 4/19?

If pricing needs internal review, please point me at who we should wait on. I can also share a short MAP with milestone dates.

Team —

Forwarding inbound from Novacare. Quick summary: strong technical fit, asking for a 6-week pilot starting asap and a 30% license credit for the first 3 months of the pilot period, tied to a MAP that leads into a 12-month ramp commit if milestones are met. They indicated readiness to sign if we can meet the timeline and discount.

Proposal from my side: offer a 30% pilot credit for months 0–3 contingent on three MAP milestones (integration by week 2, clinical validation pass by week 5, executive sign-off by week 6). If milestones are met, Novacare commits to a 12-month ramp with a minimum ARR commit of $420k. If milestones fail, discount void and we revert to list pricing plus a short-term overage charge for support.

Why I think we should approve: large healthcare customer, strategic for our HIPAA pipeline references, and this pilot will be product-market validating for our clinical vertical.

Requested action: Rishi/Laura/Neha — can you confirm approval for the pilot credit and the conditional MAP structure? I attached a draft MAP and a pricing worksheet with the math. If we need exec sign-off I can route through DocuSign once we have approval.

Thanks — Alex

Alex / Rishi —

Thanks for the context. Finance can support a promotional credit during a pilot, but with constraints:

1) We can approve up to 25% credit for months 0–3 under standard terms without additional sign-off.
2) Anything >25% requires CEO approval and a documented mitigation plan (billing protections, clawback if milestones not met). For a 30% credit we need an upfront refundable trial credit (applied to month 4 if milestones fail) and explicit revenue recognition language in the SOW.
3) We will require a purchase order or contract addendum that includes the MAP milestones and measurable KPIs. No informal email commitments.

Please update the MAP draft to add: milestone owners, acceptance criteria per milestone, and an escrow/credit clause for the promotional amount. I reviewed the pricing worksheet — the ARR ramp math looks reasonable if they commit to $420k over 12 months, but we need stronger contract-level protections.

If Neha approves the 30% exception, Finance will issue the redline SOW and the billing schedule. I’ve attached a redline with the required clauses.
